g.text: Terminal engineering cockpit for code, context, and execution.
Ready to code! What would you like to build?
Give me a tight 3-step checklist for a zero-downtime database migration.
— Deploy code that writes to both old and new databases simultaneously. Backfill
historical data to the new DB in the background. Verify data consistency between both systems before
— Gradually shift read traffic to the new database (canary → 50% → 100%) while keeping writes
dual. Monitor latency and error rates. If issues arise, revert reads back to the old DB.
— Switch writes to the new database only. Run a final consistency check. Once
confirmed stable, stop dual-writes, decommission the old database, and retire the old code.
: Always maintain a rollback path at each step. If any step fails, you can revert to the previous
